name: good_morning_chro
description: Daily CHRO executive briefing: attrition watch (new exits, trending orgs), hiring velocity (offers out, acceptances), engagement signals (pulse survey, PTO risk), and workforce hot spots needing attention. Triggers: good morning CHRO, people pulse, daily HR update, workforce health, what's happening in HR, morning briefing, daily people update. Do NOT use for: deep attrition, headcount or org health analysis (use attrition_insights, headcount_insights or org_health_report), individual employee lookups, or compensation analysis.
